editorial:
Imagine you just had a baby and you feel completely lost and alone. That is exactly where you find the main character in this story. She is struggling with postpartum depression and feels like she does not fit in with the other perfect moms at her group. Then, she meets a mysterious and charming woman who seems to understand everything she is going through. It starts off as a sweet friendship, but you will quickly realize that something is very wrong. The vibe is tense and creepy, making you wonder if the main character is just stressed out or if she is actually in danger.

The acting is solid and the plot keeps you guessing until the end. While some parts feel a bit like a typical TV movie, the twists are surprising enough to keep you glued to your screen. If you enjoy stories about secrets and dangerous friendships, you will love this. You should check it out by streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture quality. If you prefer to own your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move so you can watch it whenever you want.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the new friend is actually a dangerous predator who targets vulnerable mothers. She tries to take over the main character's life and steal her baby. In the final scenes, a violent struggle breaks out. The mother finally finds her strength and fights back to protect her child. She manages to stop the woman for good, ensuring her family is safe and finally getting the help she needs for her depression.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and stories about secret identities.
